systems.name: full_stud_ui_suite
systems.title: Complete Stud UI Suite + Economy Server
systems.description: Installs StudUI, StudMotion, CheckUIIcons (1,022 icons), DataStoreSafe & FormatNumber, generates the full HUD + Shop + Daily Rewards + Rebirth + Rarity Index directly into StarterGui (visible immediately in Edit Mode), wires HUD buttons & modal controllers, and installs a live Coin/Rebirth server script.

scripts.name: StudEconomyServer
scripts.source:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local DataStoreSafe = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("DataStoreSafe"))

local store = DataStoreSafe.createProfileStore("ArenaStudEconomy_v1", {
	Coins = 250,
	Gems = 25,
	Rebirths = 0,
	DailyDay = 1,
}, {
	{ key = "Coins", name = "Coins" },
	{ key = "Gems", name = "Gems" },
	{ key = "Rebirths", name = "Rebirths" },
})

local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("StudRemotes")
if not remotes then
	remotes = Instance.new("Folder")
	remotes.Name = "StudRemotes"
	remotes.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

local actionFn = remotes:FindFirstChild("EconomyAction")
if not actionFn then
	actionFn = Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
	actionFn.Name = "EconomyAction"
	actionFn.Parent = remotes
end

actionFn.OnServerInvoke = function(player, action, payload)
	if type(action) ~= "string" then
		return { ok = false, reason = "Invalid action" }
	end
	local profile = store:Get(player)
	if not profile then
		return { ok = false, reason = "Profile loading" }
	end
	if action == "BuyItem" then
		local cost = math.max(0, tonumber(payload and payload.cost) or 100)
		if profile.Coins < cost then
			return { ok = false, reason = "Need " .. tostring(cost) .. " Coins", coins = profile.Coins }
		end
		store:Update(player, function(d)
			d.Coins = d.Coins - cost
		end)
		return { ok = true, coins = profile.Coins }
	elseif action == "Rebirth" then
		local req = 500 * ((profile.Rebirths or 0) + 1)
		if profile.Coins < req then
			return { ok = false, reason = "Need " .. tostring(req) .. " Coins" }
		end
		store:Update(player, function(d)
			d.Coins = 0
			d.Rebirths = (d.Rebirths or 0) + 1
		end)
		return { ok = true, rebirths = profile.Rebirths }
	elseif action == "ClaimDaily" then
		store:Update(player, function(d)
			d.Coins = d.Coins + 150
		end)
		return { ok = true, coins = profile.Coins }
	end
	return { ok = true, coins = profile.Coins }
end

scripts.name: StudHudWiring
scripts.source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local FormatNumber = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("FormatNumber"))
local StudMotion = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("StudMotion"))

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local pgui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local function toggleGui(menuName)
	local target = pgui:FindFirstChild(menuName)
	if not target then
		return
	end
	local ev = target:FindFirstChild("Basculer")
	if ev and ev:IsA("BindableEvent") then
		ev:Fire()
	else
		target.Enabled = not target.Enabled
	end
end

local routes = {
	Shops = "MenuNestShop",
	Shop = "MenuNestShop",
	Rebirth = "MenuRebirth",
	Daily = "MenuDaily",
	DailyRewards = "MenuDaily",
	Index = "Index",
}

for _, screen in ipairs(pgui:GetChildren()) do
	if screen:IsA("ScreenGui") and not screen:GetAttribute("MenuModal") then
		for _, desc in ipairs(screen:GetDescendants()) do
			if desc:IsA("GuiButton") then
				StudMotion.Button(desc)
				local dest = routes[desc.Name] or (desc.Parent and routes[desc.Parent.Name])
				if dest then
					desc.Activated:Connect(function()
						toggleGui(dest)
					end)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local ls = player:WaitForChild("leaderstats", 10)
if ls then
	local coins = ls:WaitForChild("Coins", 5)
	if coins then
		local function refreshMoney()
			local hud = pgui:FindFirstChild("HUDArgent")
			if hud then
				for _, lbl in ipairs(hud:GetDescendants()) do
					if lbl:IsA("TextLabel") then
						lbl.Text = "$" .. FormatNumber.commas(coins.Value)
						break
					end
				end
			end
		end
		coins.Changed:Connect(refreshMoney)
		refreshMoney()
	end
end
